text:
Elena: OK team — CloudPulse marketplace listing + integration launch is going live next month. main ask: how do we route inbound leads from the marketplace + webinar so partner gets proper credit and we don’t double-touch?
Kai: Love it. We should define a single source-of-truth tag on all assets: utm_source=cloudpulse + tag marketplace:cloudpulse in the payload. then HubSpot workflows can pick that up.
Ravi: For the webinar signup form, capture: company, email, role, region, integration_interest (checkboxes), and an optional 'share with partner' checkbox. need legal sign-off for sharing.
Tess: +1. Also add a hidden field campaign=cloudpulse_integration_launch and campaign_id=CP-0426 so SFDC campaign attribution is clean.
Max: Legal has a short template for opt-in for third-party share — I can paste it into the form. also confirm whether partner expects a nightly lead push or real-time webhook.
Elena: Partner prefers nightly SFTP drop with CSV, but they're open to webhook if we sign the DSAs. for now plan: nightly push + HubSpot -> SFDC mapping.
Kai: Proposed routing matrix (quick):
- Leads with integration_interest=high and role in (PM, Eng, DevRel) -> Partner SDR queue (tag: partner:cloudpulse)
- Leads with enterprise email domain or >1000 employees -> Redwood AE nurture -> notify partner
- All other leads -> joint nurture stream (co-branded)
(we’ll map to HS lists + SFDC queues)
Ravi: Can we add a simple MQL rule: activity_score >= 50 OR demo_request=true -> AE notify + create SFDC opportunity placeholder.
Tess: For the nightly CSV, CSV columns should be: email, first_name, last_name, company, country, role, integration_interest, utm_source, campaign_id, hs_contact_id, partner_opt_in. sample header:
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,country,role,integration_interest,utm_source,campaign_id,hs_contact_id,partner_opt_in
```
Elena: Assignments: Kai = HubSpot workflow + tags (due 4/20), Tess = SFDC campaign mapping + legal opt-in text (due 4/22), Ravi = webinar form + registration page (due 4/18), Max = partner SFTP + encryption keys (due 4/21). I’ll draft co-branded nurture emails.
Max: I set up an SFTP placeholder and uploaded test.csv — orion-bot confirms connection.
orion-bot: Calendar invite created: "CloudPulse launch ops sync" 4/15 10:00am PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/CP-launch-sync
Ravi: Also — quick CTA alignment for blog + webinar landing: headline options: 
1) "Ship LLM-powered search faster with Redwood + CloudPulse"
2) "Scale inference for product integrations — Redwood meets CloudPulse"
Pick 1 and I’ll iterate.
Kai: Option 2 feels more product-forward. keep 1 as test headline for ads.
Tess: Reminder: tracking matrix doc -> https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/cloudpulse-tracking. Put final UTMs there.
Elena: Good progress. follow-ups: please drop HubSpot workflow screenshots in the doc when done, and add a sample nightly CSV into /marketing/partner-drops/cloudpulse-test.csv. final check-in at 4/15 sync. :raised_hands:
